description: 25 feature tests for KisanSahayak, written by the team. Cases with mode 'text' are run automatically by evalset/run_evalset.py; 'photo' and 'voice' cases are checked by hand in the app (see evalset/questions.md).

checks.intent: the router's intent is one of the listed values
checks.section: the top retrieved advisory section contains this text
checks.answer_any: the answer contains at least one of these (case-insensitive)
checks.answer_all: the answer contains all of these (case-insensitive)
checks.answer_none: the answer contains none of these (case-insensitive)
checks.script: the answer is written in this script (gurmukhi or devanagari)
checks.district: the weather answer is for this place
checks.no_advisory: no advisory is shown at all (for crops the advisories do not cover)

cases.feature: Photo diagnosis: upload and take a photo of a covered crop
cases.manual: Type 'My wheat leaves look like this, what should I spray?', attach data/sample_photos/02_wheat_leaf_rust.jpg with +, press send once. Pass: one message with photo and text; identifies rust on wheat, treatment from the advisory, 'AI estimate, confirm with your KVK' note. Repeat with Take a photo on a phone.

cases.feature: Photo diagnosis: crop the advisories do not cover
cases.manual: Attach data/sample_photos/08_chilli_leaf_curl.jpg with + and send. Pass: names the problem but says it is not covered, gives no treatment, refers to the KVK.

cases.feature: Voice: live recording in English and Punjabi, answer read aloud
cases.manual: Microphone in the chat box -> record 'How to control aphids in mustard?' -> stop -> send. Pass: transcript shown as the question, mustard aphid answer read aloud. Repeat in Punjabi: 'ਸਰ੍ਹੋਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਚੇਪੇ ਦੀ ਰੋਕਥਾਮ ਕਿਵੇਂ ਕਰੀਏ?' (can take 10-20 s). Then record a question and attach a photo, and send both together.
